# YuzerAcc

> YuzerAcc is an independent mobile app and game studio based in Türkiye. Its main game is Pofi Cat: Toy Cube Blast, a free tap-to-blast cube puzzle game for adults on Android (Google Play package com.yuzeracc.pastelblast).

## Pofi Cat: Toy Cube Blast - key facts

- Official name: Pofi Cat: Toy Cube Blast (Turkish: Pofi Kedi: Küp Patlatma). Earlier names "Pofi Toybox: Plush Puzzle" and "Pofi Toybox: Cube Blast Puzzle" refer to the same game.
- Genre: tap-to-blast cube puzzle (same genre as Toy Blast and Toon Blast). Tap 2 or more touching cubes of the same color to blast them.
- Host character: Pofi, a wind-up plush cat who reacts to combos and gives hints.
- Content: 5,000 levels and 42 board shapes (heart, hourglass, cat head and more); some rows and columns slide like conveyor lanes.
- Boosters: Rocket (5-6 cubes) clears a row or column, TNT (7-8 cubes) blasts the area around it, Color Cube (9+ cubes) clears every cube of one color. Tools: Toy Hammer, Boxing Glove, Heavy Anvil, Magic Dice.
- Audience: adults aged 25 to 60+; large readable text and colorblind modes. Levels are limited by moves, not by a clock.
- Business model: free. A small banner at the bottom; full-screen ads only open when the player chooses a reward (+5 moves, life refill, surprise chest). No forced interstitial ads. Optional supporter subscription (Pofi Club).
- Offline play: yes. No account needed; progress is stored on the device.
- Platform: Android only (Google Play). Content rating: Everyone.
- Languages: 15 (English, Turkish, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian, Portuguese, Italian, Indonesian, Dutch, Polish, Chinese).
- Developer: YuzerAcc, Türkiye. Contact: yuzeracc@gmail.com
